entry_points.text: Realtime hooks evaluate push on wakeup, sync overload on hotplug, handle class change and priority change.
Tick refreshes accounting and rotates slices; interval returns slice or zero; accessor returns local queue.
Nice clamps and checks permission; setters validate and delegate; getters adjust and negotiate size.
Affinity checks ownership and security; yield delegates; handover needs shared class; quantum serves two layouts.
Energy toggle needs privilege and rebuilds on change; NUMA finds nth CPU; cache refresh corrects shares.

exports.text: Overload drain runs as interrupt work; domain release defers reclaim until last reference drops.
Wait queues offer init, single and full wake, exclusive and event prepare, and finish.
Policy setters, affinity accessors, priority and idle helpers and direct yield are exposed.
Topology publishes default root, cache and NUMA hints, asymmetry keys and distance tables.

hazards.text: Push races need revalidation; domain and performance teardown use deferred reclaim to avoid use after free.
Stop misuse is fatal; bad attributes copy faults and missing targets fail; affinity needs capability and hook.

Wakeup cause bits plus sync migrated and selector markers; enqueue dequeue mirror low bits with high extensions; clock marks skip updated.
Affinity one two four eight; bandwidth shift twenty ratio eight; migrate batch eight or thirty two; kicks zero to three; stats seventeen.

invariants.text: Push seeks distinct CPU with better priority under balanced locks, retrying on state change without self migration.
Bandwidth updates validate runtime against period and hierarchy caps, roll back on failure and rebuild topology.
Supervision counts one timeout per tick against soft and hard limits; throttle follows grouped or per CPU queue.
Stop tasks never migrate or preempt; selection enqueue and balance mirror runnability with empty tick.
PID zero means current; attribute copy enforces size and clamp rules; parameter read varies by policy.
Classes live in dedicated section with active skipping; fair runnable means positive queued count.
Energy needs asymmetry, no SMT, invariant accounting, ready control, enabled toggle and model data.
Asym preference tracks best CPU; relax parses at boot with frozen topology; stats print versioned counters.

locks.text: Bandwidth and removal locks nest inside runqueue lock; forwarding serializes next target choice.
Local access uses interrupt saving raw acquisition with scoped guards for task irq and raw variants.
Paired locks order by address with nesting annotation and scoped automatic release.
Wait queues use per queue lock; affinity and stats hold read protection; handover holds both queues; partitions need mutex.

state_machines.text: Overload chains CPU to CPU until none remains then drops reference; round robin cycles countdown reload requeue.
Stats iterate header then online CPUs; event prepare aborts on signal; full wake drains incrementally.
Stop yield switch and priority change are fatal except unchanged; performance sets publish with deferred reclaim.

Realtime queue pairs priority array with cached priorities and pushable list; deadline uses ordered tree with utilization.
Fair queue aggregates load vruntime and throttling; bandwidth adds quota timers; clamp uses value count buckets.
Root domain aggregates spans overload masks bandwidth and energy list; groups are circular counted sets with capacity.
Task group anchors hierarchies; class defines queue balance migration hooks; affinity carries masks and flags.
Extension queue centers on dispatch lists with rescue budget; realtime bandwidth pairs lock with period and timer.
